description: This file defines a utility module for aggregating agent usage and cost data from MongoDB collections, supporting filtering by tenant, project, and date range. It includes a main function 'aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost' that performs complex aggregation pipelines and merges results.

methods.name: toNumberSafe
methods.description: Converts currency-like strings and other inputs to a safe number, handling nulls, undefined, and formatted strings.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost
methods.description: Aggregates agent costs and usage data from MongoDB collections, supporting filters and merging multiple data sources into a summarized report.
